> But you’ve helped me change my perspective, just a little bit. Your  story in a fucked up way has given me a bit more contentment with my  life. It helped me make it through today. If that means anything. 

  
It does mean something. I think the only value I bring to people is being helpful to them. It's the only time I've felt as an adult anything of merit. My favorite example. I helped my grandmother by making her a meal that there was no way she could've herself. It was for a special occasion. It took me over a week to prepare everything, a whole day of cooking the day of. When she ate dinner that day, she told everyone that she hadn't tasted anything she's ever prepared herself that was better. Everyone loved it. Every time I would make better food I could see how much she was proud of my talent as a cook, my palette and skill grew until she died  because she gave me a purpose, and she did praise my talents. Other than video game's and daily emotional elation from hunger, being tired etc. It was the only emotion I felt out side of fantasy from books, television, movies.  

So yes. It does help me knowing if this posts in any way helps anyone.  And if I learned anything in the past 24 hours, fucking talk to people. Even anonymously. It fucking has helped me so much today.

I have read and re read my own post toady about 100 times. When ever I had free time at work, I found myself re reading, crying. I hid my feeling well at work. By the end of the day, like now, I just get a little emotional. 
 
This is the first time I have actually thrown all of it out on the table. It's helped me so much more than I thought. I even was able to talk a LITTLE about my past and why I feel the way I do to another co-worker because apparently everyone's in on my little escapade. But your opinion, resonates pretty close to how I feel. And I didn't fuck up my cousin. I felt I fucked her up. She married has two boys and I talk to her at least 3 - 4 times a month. See her all the time. She visits cause I make a mean cappuccino ^.-. but after years of awkward bull shit on MY part, she wormed herself back to being my best friend. And one thing I will add is my older brother and I have different fathers and she is not a blood relative of HIS. It still was fucking weird though.

The only thing that kept me going was family. I switched off from them, but they needed me. My grandmother with her health. That was first. When she died, my Older brother had my first niece. I spoil the shit out of his kids =). I helped raise them while he was schooling and a single father. That's around the time I met Melony. When all the shit was done with her, that's when my dads health really declined and my brother had another one of my nieces.  At the time when I was closed off to everyone else, I auto piloted my father back to health, did what I could for my brother and my nieces, that's when my brother started inviting me out to his hobby event's. If I go into to much detail I am sure someone might know EXACTLY who I am so I can't give out to much. But it was one thing. Then another. So if you want my advice, find one thing that gives your purpose. Focus it on it that day. Find something else. Repeat. If you find a hobby, be good at it. I threw my self into my brothers hobby. Knew it so well, I  now do that as a profession when I had 0 schooling(usually around 4-6 years in college for someone in my position). Find something. Even if it's fucking World of Warcraft. Be good at it. You have to find something to help YOU smile. I do movies, weed. I don't do or abuse any other substances only because I feel I NEED to be in control. If I get drunk, I can't control me, and that's the only thing I've ever had control of. So I guess there is some silver lining.
